$sources: ACI 318-19 Chapter 16 (16.2): precast concrete connections, integrity ties, bearing; 22.8: bearing strength; 16.3.4 / 22.9: shear friction
SAEngine practice where ACI 318-19 16.2.1.1 asks for the handling stages and gives no values: PCI Design Handbook (8th ed.) handling multipliers and Mast's hanging beam stability; see VERIFY.md

sources.bearing: ACI 318-19 16.2.6.2 (ln/180, at least 50 mm solid or hollow-core slabs, 75 mm beams or stemmed members; pads set back 13 mm from unarmoured edges, 16.2.6.2(b)); 22.8.3.2: bearing 0.85 f'c A1, phi 0.65 (21.2.1)
sources.dowel: ACI 318-19 16.2.2.4, 22.9: shear friction across the joint
sources.connections.tensionShare: ACI 318-19 16.2.2.3 (restraint forces from shrinkage, creep and temperature); 0.2 Vu as for corbels, 16.5.3.5: SAEngine practice where none is entered
sources.integrity: ACI 318-19 16.2.4.2-16.2.4.3 and 16.2.5.1: 4.4 kN/m (300 lb/ft) diaphragm connections, columns 1.4 Ag N (200 Ag lb), two 44 kN (10,000 lb) ties per panel; bearing wall structures 3 storeys or more: floor ties 22 kN/m (1500 lb/ft) at most 3 m (10 ft) apart, perimeter ties 71 kN (16,000 lb) within 1.2 m (4 ft), vertical ties 44 kN/m (3000 lb/ft)
sources.handling: SAEngine practice (ACI 318-19 16.2.1.1, 26.9 give no values): PCI Design Handbook 8th ed. equivalent static multipliers, cracking 7.5 sqrt(f'ci) psi = 0.62 sqrt(f'ci) MPa over 1.5, insert safety factor 4; f'ci = 0.7 f'c when not entered
sources.erection: SAEngine practice: erection wind 0.5 kPa, safety 1.5; hanging members by Mast (PCI Journal 1989, 1993), FS 1.5, sweep L/960, insert tolerance 6 mm
